changes.description: Fixed Atheist preference handling and selection odds.
Added a script-viewer category for Fabled and Lorics, with readable Bootlegger rules.
Added Tor mode for synced players: they see Tor while the storyteller reveals their character manually. Pope and Tor settings persist through resets.
Clearing reminders now also clears Drunk/Poisoned status in Standard, Whale Bucket, and Game Notes.
Added the active script's Outsider reminders and night actions for players assigned the Hermit.
Added Cacklejack's Not Me reminder and clarified Alchemist, Boffin, Philosopher, and Pixie markers for tracking character changes.
Added synced spectator Game Notes, late-join spectating, and promotion from spectator to Traveler. Spectators can choose whether to join the next game after a reset.
Added storyteller controls to kick, ban, or move connected players to spectators, with room bans preserved through reloads and resets.
Improved sync reconnects and preserved local notes and character guesses. Protected synced player names while allowing players to claim manually added seats.
Added fullscreen Game Notes with live player updates, larger rotation controls, and responsive day and alive-player badges.
Added a toggleable join code, QR code, and join link to fullscreen synced Game Notes.
Improved character-exclusion search and Traveler name suggestions, showed skulls for dead Game Notes players without assigned characters, and simplified Join Game script labels.
Added transfers between Standard Storyteller games and Player Notes.
Preserved valid Lunatic, Marionette, and Lil' Monsta tags when characters change, and unified Marionette eligibility checks.
Added Pope, Sentinel, and other setup modifier controls for customizing game setup.
Renamed Whale Buffet to Whale Bucket Draft and improved its responsive setup and assignment layouts.
Fixed script-limited Outsider counts, excluded-character assignment, and Lil' Monsta Minion preferences in Whale Bucket.
Setup Modifiers and Grimoire Balance Verification now remember whether they are expanded.
Added the weekly changelog, a collapsible night-order guide, and a current grimoire distribution summary.
Improved Game Notes responsiveness, ledger reorder feedback, and grimoire recap images.
Applied Lil' Monsta holder setup modifiers and tightened character assignment safeguards for tag roles, Summoner conflicts, and impossible selections.
Simplified Whale Bucket assignment with clearer Auto-Assign and Clear Roles actions.
Made the grimoire ledger collapsible on desktop and clarified hidden-role terminology.
Improved Whale Bucket's mobile setup and Setup Bag flow, and fixed Atheist counts plus Legion and Kazali assignment edge cases.
Fixed flexible-count assignments and followed BOTC ordering in two-column script views.
Allowed late Travelers in Whale Bucket games up to the 20-player limit.
Expanded the default Whale Bucket character exclusion list.
Improved Discord recaps by distinguishing character types from player alignments.
Added a custom pronoun option to the pronoun pickers.
Added a list of relevant jinxes for the active script.
Added built-in script presets for Trouble Brewing, Sects & Violets, and Bad Moon Rising.
Added a Storyteller reminder to prepare Savant information.
Improved player-label and dead-token presentation on the grimoire.
Moved Reset Game, settings, theme, and grimoire display controls into the header menu.
Unified pronoun pickers and added a persistent settings dropdown to Player Notes.
Showed the held character's ability for the Drunk and allowed one to three Village Idiots.
Improved Discord recaps, in-play Traveler script sheets, and the alive-player count.
Added a print-style script detail view and an in-play character filter.
Added pronoun controls, vote tokens, and custom Storyteller note prompts.
Added character deselection to the draft and player-details modals.
Added Tiny Grimoire branding and richer Discord game recaps.
Added Sentinel and Fabled controls with a collapsible setup widget.
Added custom-script night orders, reminders, labels, and custom reminder icons.
Improved token and tracker controls, custom-script teams, validation messages, duplicate-character safeguards, and automatic grimoire rotation.
Added reminder tokens and read-only note sharing to Player Notes.
Added drag-and-drop token swaps, grimoire confirmation, and clearer loading states.
Added setup-bag filtering and step-by-step night order controls.
Improved Marionette bluffing and balance calculations.
Added confirmation before clearing all assigned characters.
Corrected Riot setup counts and warned when a displayed token reveals a hidden character state.
Added Bounty Hunter setup behavior, Player Notes, and peer-to-peer multiplayer game sharing.
Added active-script details, Traveler support in script views, and reset notifications for joined players.
Added grimoire reminder tokens and Demon Bluffs selection with a reveal overlay.
Added automatic game logs, winner declaration, and downloadable recaps.
Launched Tiny Grimoire with Whale Bucket Draft, Standard Setup, custom scripts, and responsive grimoire layouts.
Added day and night cycles, character assignment, Travelers, and drag-and-drop seating.

Added night-order guidance, character abilities, dead-vote tracking, and special setup handling for characters such as the Drunk, Marionette, Lunatic, Lil' Monsta, Kazali, Xaan, Legion, Riot, and Lord of Typhon.
